before: Before compatibility mode 15, every footnote referenced in a whole row taller than the page moved to the next page.
after: The page of a whole row taller than the page keeps the first line of its first footnote at the page bottom, unless a footnote carried from an earlier page waits for room; the rest continues on the next page.
reason: Only local layout geometry changes. Canonical XML, replicated operations, and saved rooms remain unchanged.
